title: SWF: ActionGetURL for HTML links
description: Verify getURL(url, target) compiles correctly to ActionGetURL2 (0x9A) when called with 2 args, and ActionGetURL (0x83) or getURL2 variant for navigateToURL-style calls. Also test FSCommand('fullscreen','true') compiles. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/geturl.test.ts.
